intro: The human replied yes to the concrete finite baseline interface and test seams, plus a finite-owner-only session exception. Design v2 geometry remains agreed. Dark Start here nodes mark graph entry; numbered edges give order. These workflow/dependency graphs are not checked models or product evidence.

discussion.title: Finite interface and Q1–Q3 public repairs agreed
discussion.status: Scoped reply: Approve Q1–Q3 as written — product acceptance outstanding
discussion.summary: The canonical spec clarifies durable replay before currency/packet integrity, single-use receipts, snapshot identity, executable resume/new-import remedies and kernel ownership. Global review changes require a packet refresh before every subsequent action: 20 native tiles need 19 refreshes and inspection of the refreshed covered views. The human separately approved Q1 reason domains, Q2 result/help grammar and Q3 distinct issuance as written. Permanent finite names and the finite-only session exception remain agreed; complete browser B still precedes orientation and assesses its own size.

updatedDiagrams.summary: Exposed the signed global refresh cost and single-use receipt workflow, with distinct issuance separately approved; native scale remains an observed requirement.
Clarified receipt authenticity then durable replay, new-action currency/integrity, non-inherited lock ownership and executable resume/new-import remedies.
Recorded separate scoped Q1–Q3 approval alongside the original yes and finite-only cadence permission; complete F/B ownership and browser size assessment remain.

diagrams.title: Finite views and exact revision actions
diagrams.caption: Agreed workflow. Full/native/source-native views carry stable identity; actual native-scale usability remains required working acceptance. No geometry edit or inferred inspection.

diagrams.title: Saved review and output publication
diagrams.caption: Agreed operation/ownership graph, not a checked state machine. Checkpoint commit and PDF publication have distinct signal outcomes; private incomplete assets never resume.

diagrams.title: Complete finite handoff then browser completion
diagrams.caption: Agreed responsibility/dependency map, not source-package or deployment containers. One-session fit for F is unsubstantiated; the actual yes permits one complete finite owner across sessions without waived checks. B remains required before orientation.

diagrams.title: Geometry PDF and external passes
diagrams.caption: Design v2 preserves every occurrence/order. The 300-dpi RGB baseline re-rasterises input; source-fidelity and changed CropBox extent stay explicit. Confirmed halves use source region, rotation, rotated-frame crop, then placement. Export adds no further sampling. Full within-page acceptance remains outstanding.

diagrams.title: Page sides and mirrored alignment
diagrams.caption: Body runs assign sides independently of geometry groups; explicit repeats retain a side without advancing parity. Frames guide registration without cropping. White translation/padding preserves scale and retained pixels; canvases may grow. Unpositioned members retain their own canvas unresolved. Images are never mirrored.

diagrams.title: Page correction and book placement
diagrams.caption: Source/baseline/current full and labelled native views support any-page review; pair/group views expose added bands, margins and sides. Drafts and stale placements block export until accepted/discarded or removed. Snapshot acknowledgement can retain unresolved baselines without accepting rotation or implying inspection.

diagrams.title: Geometry dependencies stay consistent
diagrams.caption: Reference-image edits invalidate all dependent placements and require re-marked anchors; member overflow reopens target review. Authenticated versioned actions and a kernel-released writer lock protect durable checkpoints. Export freezes one snapshot and includes a readable JSON attachment, omitting preparation hints. Reimport starts fresh.
